visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor trash collection area, a man in a black-and-white striped sweater and a woman with vibrant orange hair and a beige dress are engaged in a disagreement. The woman tosses a pink trash bag into a green bin while the man looks on disapprovingly. (2) The man points emphatically at the recycling bins, his facial expression one of annoyance. The woman holds her ground, holding another plastic bag, with a dismissive and defiant look. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear to emphasize their speech. (3) The two main characters stand close together, arguing animatedly. The man uses sharp hand gestures to indicate the different bins, while the woman waves her bag and rolls her eyes. The background shows structured green waste containers with recycling labels. (4) The man, appearing to lose his patience, begins grabbing large cardboard boxes and throwing them haphazardly into the corner of the trash area. His movements are fast and aggressive. The woman watches, pointing her finger and shouting in reaction to his sudden outburst. (5) The conflict reaches a climax as the man continues to toss items onto the floor, ignoring the previous rules he championed. The woman reacts with high-arousal facial expressions, seemingly calling out for a manager as the scene ends.
